stem:
Gita’s torch uses a dry cell that lights the bulb for several evenings and then is thrown away. Her phone uses a battery that is connected to a charger and used again many times.

Which classification is correct?

options.text: The phone battery is rechargeable because it can be recharged and reused many times.
The dry cell is rechargeable because it powers the torch on several evenings before it is exhausted.
The phone battery is single-use because every battery eventually stops working.
The dry cell is rechargeable because it was bought in a shop for a torch.

teacher.key_rationale: Rechargeable means restored by charging and reused for many cycles. Several evenings of use before disposal is still single-use; eventual failure does not make a rechargeable cell single-use; shop packaging does not decide rechargeability.
